game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of sulfur crystals is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of sulfur crystals is fair. Each round, molten golems strike the ember furnace, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from molten golems in Pumice Pass: keep the fair_trades meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: fair_trades drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while fair_trades > 0.
